_note: citycov (9 Nov 2026): Dhaka leguna (human hauler) routes and BRTC / Dhaka Nagar Paribahan / 1 Nov 2026 franchise bus routes that news reports say RUN (planned-only routes — DTCA plan list, Nagar Paribahan 23-25, unlaunched franchise routes — are left out on purpose; BRTC pink buses live in dhaka_women_buses.json; dhakabusservice.com pages are already crawled). Collected from public news pages only (no logins); every route keeps its source links and dates; 'snippet': true = seen in a search-result snippet only. The build marks a route Verified only when 2+ different publishers (not snippets) list it, else Reported. Legunas are often informal and reports date 2018-2026: they stay Reported until trips / field reports confirm. Routes whose stops do not match 3+ known places are skipped by the build (report gaps).
